_comment: One session's metric on the wire, exactly as the client posts it to POST /v1/metrics/sessions (ST-098).
Read by both ends and by neither's production code, like publish-request.v1.json: the client's sender
writes this shape, the backend's SessionMetricRequest reads it, and the field names ARE the contract.
This list is also what Settings shows beside the usage-telemetry toggle (Spec S6): the exact fields
sent. Nothing here is content (INV-10): no note text, no ticket, no company, no transcript, no window
title. edit_ratio is the share of the draft's steps the technician changed before publishing; null
until published. A retry with the same session_id replaces the row rather than adding one.
